title: BotVolatileContext v1

sessionId.description: Must equal the attributed principal's sessionId; 1-200 Unicode scalars.

request.description: Exactly {sessionId}; no other member is accepted.

revision.description: Monotonic per producer instance; an attempted (even failed) snapshot still consumes a revision.

variant.description: At most 12000 Unicode scalars; empty is omitted. See tool-contracts.md §8.

persona.description: At most 12000 Unicode scalars; empty is omitted. See tool-contracts.md §8.

memory.description: At most 4000 Unicode scalars; empty is omitted. See tool-contracts.md §8.

automation.description: At most 4000 Unicode scalars; empty is omitted. See tool-contracts.md §8.

blocks.description: Block text is assembled from variant, persona, memory and automation. The teammates sub-block is appended to automation, not a fifth block. Caps are Unicode scalars: variant/persona 12000, memory/automation 4000, total 24000.

response.description: schemaVersion is always 1. revision starts at 1 per producer instance and increases per attempt. blocks omits empty blocks; an empty provider returns {}.

description: BotVolatileContext tool request/response as frozen by tool-contracts.md §8. Request carries exactly sessionId (1-200 Unicode scalars) and it must equal the attributed principal session. Blocks are Unicode-scalar capped: variant/persona 12000, memory/automation 4000, total 24000; failures return a tool error, never a stale snapshot.
